description: On the bed in front of the person, there is a white AirPods charging case. The right hand reaches to the case on the right side, brings it toward the center, and opens it while the left hand comes in to steady the case as a two-hand object; then the right hand pinches and lifts out an earbud and sets it down on the bed, and by the end both earbuds are out and resting on the bed near the now-closed case.
